remarks: Refined coastal living meets effortless sophistication in this beautifully reimagined, single-level residence within Newport Beach’s coveted guard-gated Sea Island community. Spanning approximately 2,600 square feet, this extensively remodeled three-bedroom, three-bath home blends custom craftsmanship, elevated finishes, and modern convenience. Light-filled interiors feature Italian porcelain accents, custom illuminated cabinetry, and an inviting living room anchored by a statement fireplace.
